amendment_reason: The v1 raw-LFP screen was restricted to uninterrupted >=1-second movement bouts. Native-data diagnostics showed 49-97 percent of matched RUN bins in shorter bouts, despite continuous LFP. Assess fixed native LFP windows independently of behavior; retain every spectral threshold and all cohort/event rules. Frozen before any RUN-coordination association.
cohort: Exactly the original 16 earliest nonoverlapping supported pauses; no replacement, including zero-event pauses.
theta_spectral_rule: Nonoverlapping 2-second windows anchored at native LFP sample zero, independent of movement and spikes. Each included window must have at least 1 second of native data and entirely valid guarded phase; no concatenation across unusable LFP. Require the raw-LFP Welch peak in 4-14 Hz to fall in 7-11 Hz and mean theta/adjacent-band density ratio >=1.5. Unsupported windows remain in the denominator. Apply this local support to the unchanged matched RUN bins.
theta_reference_rule: Unchanged lowest-numbered non-bad downsampled CA1 channel per hemisphere from the verified input census.
claim_boundary: This prospective measurement amendment is not a biological result or permission to relax theta thresholds. Independently validate all banks and spectra. Preserve v1 outputs and its failed screen; PF theta remains missing. Curated units are not automatically pyramidal; candidate bursts are not validated replay.
